hook.name: RestakeHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook with a trading gate (swaps revert until the owner calls enableTrading), a 3% buy/sell tax taken in the pool's reHOOK token and held as a restaking reward reserve, and a 0.5%-of-supply max-transaction limit. Liquidity providers earn layered restaking rewards: each additional deposit increments a layer and increases the provider's share of collected tax rewards.
